assets.title: Pericardial effusion
assets.media_type: real clinical ultrasound cine and extracted still
assets.author: Ben Smith, Ultrasound of the Week
assets.licence_evidence: The individual Commons file records the original creator, source and CC BY-SA 4.0 licence; its permission link points to the archived site licence.
changes: Transcoded to H.264 MP4 without changing sequence or playback speed.

assets.clinical_caption: Recognise pericardial fluid and inspect right-sided chamber motion in an apical cine from a published tamponade teaching case.
